logline: When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 42; inside the ruined cathedral, Alexander confronts Rupert before the congregation, armed with evidence from the Crown to reclaim his rightful title.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Rupert Ashburn standing before the altar, trembling with mounting panic and rage.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Hysterical, Panicked)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: You're lying!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Shrieking, Frantic)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: This man is an imposter! Arrest him!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Enraged, Screaming)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: I said arrest him!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Firm, Defiant)
segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
segments.text: We will not.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Outraged, Stunned)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Your Duke!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

segments.label: ROYAL GUARD (Calm, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
segments.text: No. He is your Duke.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Flustered)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: You have all been deceived!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then let the Crown decide.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave, Powerful)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Commanding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Read the first.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Crisp sound of parchment turning.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Clear, Formal)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Solemn, Objective)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Accusing, Measured)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Voice Continuing)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Terrified)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: No...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Implacable)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Read the names.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Deliberate, Damning)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Lord Henry Sterling.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Rupert Ashburn.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Shaken, Devastated)
segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
segments.text: My God...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Thunderous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You sold my men to the enemy.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Desperate, Denying)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: I didn't!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Resonant, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: And when you believed I was dead...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Venomous)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You took my title.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Grave, Official)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Continuing)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

segments.label: CROWN OFFICIAL (Loud, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
segments.text: His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Screaming, Desperate)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: I was told he was dead!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Penetrating)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: You were told exactly what you needed to hear.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Frantic, Betraying)
segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
segments.text: Sterling handled the report!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Shocked, Murmuring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: My Lord?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lord Sterling frantically unlatching the heavy oak church door and pulling it open.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Reverse angle from inside the doorway showing a stern British Police Constable standing directly outside, blocking the passage.

segments.label: POLICE CONSTABLE (Firm, Sardonic)
segments.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
segments.text: Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Lord Sterling's face frozen in pure terror, his jaw agape as his escape is completely cut off, holding until fade to black.
